description: Global composition and rendering defaults. Units are logical CSS pixels at size 1.0 unless noted. Values were calibrated with tools/calibration.html (see README > Stroke thickness matching).

calibration.method: tools/calibration.html. Font size = median ratio of handwritten to Cairo letter HEIGHT for matching letter forms. Thickness = vector outline thinning that brings the median typed stroke width to the median handwritten stroke width (orientation-independent estimator, see image-processor.js estimateStrokeWidth).
